== frame dash_n cursor=2,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo -n no-newline
|no-newline
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame dash_e cursor=6,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo -n no-newline
|no-newline
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo -e 'a\tb\nc'
|ab
|c
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
@0 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@0 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@2 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
@2 fg=2 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 echo
@6 fg=10 bg=default bold=0 dim=0 italic=0 underline=0 inverse=0 ~
== frame no_escapes cursor=9,20

== frame dash_capital_e cursor=12,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo -n no-newline
|no-newline
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo -e 'a\tb\nc'
|ab
|c
|

|a\tb

|a\tb
|
